Fracture Lines: Dominion · ship tokens

Every ship in the game: four plain outlines (colour them in yourself), then one in each people's colour at 1 inch, and two each at ¾ inch. Print at 100% (no scaling), cut along the circles, and point the bow the way the ship is heading. Print this page

The ConcordThe Tessan DynastiesThe Kel HivesThe Hegemony RemnantThe Vael Living Fleets

Scout Fast eyes. Unarmed.

Colony ship Founds a colony on a world you can live on. Used up.

Outpost ship Claims any system as an outpost: its exotics and its territory. Used up.

Frigate The line of battle.

Troop transport Takes an enemy world whose orbit you hold. Used up.

Cruiser Heavier guns and hull.

Dreadnought A fortress that moves.

Sentinel (the Wardens) A Warden hunter: quick, and never alone.

Colossus (the Wardens) A Warden war machine the size of a moon's mountain.

Heart (the Wardens) The Wardens' mind and forge. It never moves, mends itself, and sends out the waves. Break it and they go dark.
